theorems.name: Submission.smr_rb_transfer_functional
theorems.statement: ∀ (P N : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)), IsOpen U → ∀ L : (Eucl P → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N)) → ℝ, (∀ f g : Eucl P → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N), Continuous f → HasCompactSupport f → tsupport f ⊆ U → Continuous g → HasCompactSupport g → tsupport g ⊆ U → L (f + g) = L f + L g) → (∀ (c : ℝ) (f : Eucl P → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N)), Continuous f → HasCompactSupport f → tsupport f ⊆ U → L (c • f) = c * L f) → (∀ K : Set (Eucl P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → ∃ B : ℝ, ∀ f : Eucl P → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N), Continuous f → tsupport f ⊆ K → (∀ x, ‖f x‖ ≤ 1) → L f ≤ B) → ∃ L' : CompactlySupportedContinuousMap ↥U (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N)) →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ, (∀ K : Set ↥U, IsCompact K → ∃ B : ℝ, ∀ g : CompactlySupportedContinuousMap ↥U (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N)), (∀ y, ‖g y‖ ≤ 1) → tsupport g ⊆ K → L' g ≤ B) ∧ ∀ f : Eucl P → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N), Continuous f → HasCompactSupport f → tsupport f ⊆ U → ∃ g : CompactlySupportedContinuousMap ↥U (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N)), (∀ y : ↥U, g y = f ↑y) ∧ L f = L' g
